unlisted_practices: Using inter-model agreement as a proxy for extraction accuracy, with expert oversight targeted at shared errors and minority classes
Semantic rather than exact-string matching when scoring free-text LLM extractions

screen.reason: The study benchmarks and compares the accuracy and inter-model agreement of multiple commercial LLMs for clinical trial registry data extraction against an expert standard without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
